'''Specter Squadron''' was a specially-trained squadron of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] pilots assigned to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and the ''[[Admonitor]]'' during its tour of duty in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].
